slides.headline: One idea can fill your content week.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: Generic ideas make generic posts. Nobody remembers them.
slides.right:
Start from something
you really did.
slides.right_sub: Your real work is your best content.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Pick one real idea
slides.card: This week I learned: [idea]. Ask me 3 questions to find the best part of it.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Find 5 angles
slides.card: Give me 5 different angles on this idea: a mistake, a story, a how-to, a myth and a tip.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Pick the format
slides.card: Write angle 2 as a 6-slide carousel outline and angle 4 as a 30-second Reel script.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Test 3 hooks
slides.card: Write 3 hooks for each post. Short, specific, no clichés. Mark your favorite.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Plan the week
slides.card: Put these 5 posts in a table: day, format, hook and what the reader should do next.
slides.note: Read every draft. AI can't know your story.

slides.headline: Save this for your content week.

scenes.headline: That screenshot is a spreadsheet.
scenes.sub: Let AI read it for you.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: UPLOAD + COPY THIS
scenes.text: Turn this image into a table with columns: Date, Description, Amount. Keep the original order. Mark anything you can't read clearly with [?]. Don't guess numbers.

scenes.note: No IDs, bank details or client data.
